senses.gloss: f. (גרץ to cut, cmp. גרס) slice. Pl. גְּרִיצוֹת bread or cake formed of slices twisted together or layers above one another, twists.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Beitzah 2:6">Bets. II, 6</cite> (<cite ref="Beitzah 21b:15">21ᵇ</cite>) <he>אין אופין פִּתָּן ג׳</he> Ms. M. a. ed. Y. (ed. <he>פִּתִּין גְּרִיצִין</he>, Ar. <he>פתן גריצין</he>) they must not (on Holy Days) bake their bread in the form of twists; Y. ib. 61ᶜ bot.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 7:4">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:2">VIII</cite>), 2 <he>מוליכין עמו ג׳ לתנור</he> you may carry your cakes, to be baked with his, to the confectioner’s oven.—
